editorial.title: A Challenge Is Not a Verdict
editorial.verdict: Watch the Reel and use AI to surface objections; verify consequential objections before changing an engineering decision.
editorial.thesis: A plausible AI challenge can become another premature stopping point unless the team converts it into tests, sources and accountable review.
